metric: scripts/metrics.py metric_suite / tpr_at_fpr (TPR at FPR=1e-3, full ROC with drop_intermediate=False, np.interp); thresholds from metrics.operating_threshold on the same curve

galleries.rule: all objects above threshold in >= 2 arm x fold combinations, sorted by that count (desc) then best rank, then the first 25 distinct objects above CORAL@2000's threshold ordered by their best CORAL rank (ties: fold, then ID); objects may appear in both groups
